guide_intro: This app reads photo save files exported from an Xbox 360. First copy those files to your computer.
guide_step1:
1. Find your photos on the Xbox
Open the Xbox 360 Storage/Memory settings, choose the storage device, and find the Kinect Adventures! photo items. Older dashboards put these settings under My Xbox.
guide_step2:
2. Copy them to a USB drive
Use a USB drive recognized by your Xbox 360. Copy the photo items to it, or move them if copying is unavailable. Keep a backup of the original files.
guide_step3:
3. Export the Xbox files to your computer
Use an Xbox storage tool such as Xtaf Xplorer to extract the individual files. If it identifies games by ID, Kinect Adventures! is 4D5308ED. Photo saves are usually named PM9_* under Content/<profile>/4D5308ED/00000001. Unzip any backup archives first; do not choose a raw USB/disk image.
guide_step4:
4. Choose, preview, and extract
Click Open Kinect Adventures files and choose the main exported backup folder. You can also choose the 4D5308ED or 00000001 folder directly. Choose Export folder, review the discovered photos, check the ones you want, and click Extract selected.
guide_dates:
About dates
A filename date comes from the Xbox clock, which may have been set incorrectly. If the filename has no valid date, the app shows the file-modified date instead and labels it as a file date. That date may reflect when a backup was copied, rather than when a photo was taken.
guide_limits: GameProgress contains progress, not photos. SouvenirRecording files are animations and are not supported. Missing or fragmented photo data cannot be reconstructed.
